tools.name: Asana
tools.description: Manage tasks, projects, and workspaces in Asana. Use when the user asks about tasks, project boards, work tracking, or team coordination in Asana. Works with Asana REST API v1.0.

actions.name: list_workspaces
actions.description: List all workspaces accessible to the authenticated user

actions.name: list_projects
actions.description: List projects in a workspace with name, GID, and status

actions.name: get_project
actions.description: Get full details for a specific project by GID

actions.name: list_sections
actions.description: List sections (columns) in a project with names and GIDs

actions.name: list_tasks
actions.description: List tasks filtered by project, section, or assignee

actions.name: get_task
actions.description: Get full details for a specific task including notes, assignee, and custom fields

actions.name: search_tasks
actions.description: Search tasks in a workspace by text with filters for assignee, project, completion, and dates

actions.name: get_task_stories
actions.description: Get comments and activity history on a task

actions.name: create_task
actions.description: Create a new task with name, description, assignee, due date, and project

actions.name: update_task
actions.description: Update an existing task's fields (name, notes, assignee, due date, completion)

actions.name: add_comment
actions.description: Add a comment to a task

actions.name: add_task_to_section
actions.description: Move or add a task to a section within a project

tools.name: Fathom Meeting Intelligence
tools.description: Browse recent meetings and retrieve transcripts from Fathom. Use when the user asks about past meetings, wants to find a transcript, or needs to recall what was discussed in a recorded call.

actions.name: list_meetings
actions.description: List recent meetings from Fathom with titles, dates, durations, and recording IDs

actions.name: get_transcript
actions.description: Get the full speaker-labeled transcript for a specific meeting recording

tools.name: GoDaddy DNS
tools.description: Manage DNS records for GoDaddy domains via the GoDaddy API. Use when the user asks about DNS records, needs to add, view, or delete DNS entries, or wants to check what records exist on a domain.

actions.name: list_domains
actions.description: List all domains in the GoDaddy account with status and expiry

actions.name: get_records
actions.description: Get all DNS records for a domain

actions.name: get_records_by_type
actions.description: Get DNS records for a domain filtered by record type (A, CNAME, MX, TXT, etc.)

actions.name: add_record
actions.description: Add a new DNS record to a domain. Supports A, CNAME, MX, TXT, AAAA and other types.

actions.name: delete_record
actions.description: Delete all DNS records matching a given type and name for a domain

tools.name: Harvest Time Tracking
tools.description: Track time, manage projects, and view invoices via the Harvest API. Use when the user asks about time tracking, logging hours, or projects.

actions.name: list_projects
actions.description: List all active projects with client info and budget status

actions.name: get_project
actions.description: Get details for a specific project by ID

actions.name: list_time_entries
actions.description: List time entries with optional date and project filters

actions.name: create_time_entry
actions.description: Log time to a project. Requires project_id and task_id.

actions.name: list_project_assignments
actions.description: List project assignments showing which tasks are available for each project

tools.name: Jira
tools.description: Search, create, and manage Jira issues and projects. Use when the user asks about tickets, sprints, project boards, issue tracking, or bug reports. Works with Jira Cloud (REST API v3).

actions.name: search_issues
actions.description: Search Jira issues using JQL. Use for finding issues by project, status, assignee, label, sprint, or any criteria.

actions.name: get_issue
actions.description: Get full details for a specific Jira issue by key (e.g. PROJ-123). Returns all fields including description, comments, and linked issues.

actions.name: get_projects
actions.description: List all Jira projects accessible to the authenticated user. Returns project key, name, type, and category.

actions.name: get_transitions
actions.description: Get available status transitions for an issue. Always call this before transition_issue to find valid transition IDs.

actions.name: transition_issue
actions.description: Move an issue to a new status. Call get_transitions first to find valid transition IDs.

actions.name: create_issue
actions.description: Create a new Jira issue. Call get_projects first to confirm the project key.

actions.name: add_comment
actions.description: Add a comment to an existing Jira issue by key.

tools.name: Notion
tools.description: Search pages, read content, and query databases in Notion. Use when the user asks about notes, docs, wikis, or databases in Notion.

actions.name: search
actions.description: Search across all pages and databases by keyword

actions.name: get_page
actions.description: Get a specific Notion page by ID

actions.name: get_page_content
actions.description: Get the block content (body) of a Notion page

actions.name: list_databases
actions.description: List all databases the integration has access to

actions.name: query_database
actions.description: Query a database to get its rows/entries with optional filters

tools.name: Playwright Testing
tools.description: Run E2E tests, take screenshots, and list test suites using Playwright. Use when the user asks to run tests, check UI, or take screenshots.

actions.name: list_suites
actions.description: List all available UI automation test suites

actions.name: run_tests
actions.description: Run a specific test suite and return pass/fail results

actions.name: run_journey
actions.description: Generate and run an E2E test from a plain-English journey description. Pass a URL and what to test — Claude writes the Playwright test, runs it in a real browser, and returns pass/fail results.

actions.name: screenshot
actions.description: Take a screenshot of a URL using Playwright

tools.name: Vercel
tools.description: Deploy static files to a public Vercel URL for sharing. Use when the user wants to publish, share, or get a public link for HTML/CSS/JS files.

actions.name: deploy
actions.description: Deploy a directory of static files to Vercel and return a public URL

actions.name: deploy_html
actions.description: Deploy raw HTML content to Vercel and return a public URL. Use when you have HTML as a string and want to share it — no need to create files first.

actions.name: list_deployments
actions.description: List recent deployments for the authenticated Vercel account

actions.name: delete_deployment
actions.description: Delete a specific deployment from Vercel by its deployment ID
